mapper.select: SELECT NVL(appointment_register, 0) AS appointmentRegister, NVL(appointment_register_compare, 0) AS appointmentRegisterCompare, NVL(appointment_fetch, 0) AS appointmentFetch, NVL(appointment_fetch_compare, 0) AS appointmentFetchCompare, NVL(today_register, 0) AS todayRegister, NVL(today_register_compare, 0) AS todayRegisterCompare, NVL(refund, 0) AS refund, NVL(refund_compare, 0) AS refundCompare, NVL(outpatient_charge, 0) AS outpatientCharge, NVL(outpatient_charge_compare, 0) AS outpatientChargeCompare, NVL(outpatient_refund, 0) AS outpatientRefund, NVL(outpatient_refund_compare, 0) AS outpatientRefundCompare, NVL(prepayment, 0) AS prepayment, NVL(prepayment_compare, 0) AS prepaymentCompare, NVL(hospital_refund, 0) AS hospitalRefund, NVL(hospital_refund_compare, 0) AS hospitalRefundCompare, NVL(discharge_settlement, 0) AS dischargeSettlement, NVL(discharge_settlement_compare, 0) AS dischargeSettlementCompare FROM TR_CASH_SETTLE_OV WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
